name: Webex Channel
description: Cisco Webex messaging integration for OpenClaw

botWebhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving Webex webhook POSTs under bot token

oauthWebhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving Webex webhook POSTs under oAuth access token

webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA1 secret for verifying webhook signatures

allowFrom.description: Allowed sender emails or person IDs (dmPolicy: allowlisted)

routingAgentId.description: Agent ID used for message routing classification. Configure this agent with a lightweight model in the host openclaw.json. Defaults to 'main'.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for receiving all space messages

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for renewing the access token
